answer: The auditor that proves a junk submission collects 49% of the resulting slash, which forfeits for adversarial review out of the adversary's own capital. Because the bounty is drawn from the slashed bond, the atlas reward in the wander ledger costs the operator directly, and the anchor audit records each payout. A farm of 49 keys therefore funds the parties working against it, so growing the swarm makes it a larger target rather than a safer one. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
